name: migration-factory-plugin
description: Read documents, statements, sites and exports; work out whose facts they are; and write them into a Digital Twin layer as a replayable ops file. Ships six skills — dto-fill (a source into the graph), dto-fill-via-web (the graph's empty fields out of a website), a lite quick pass of each (two pages in, five nodes out, company first, one round, no creates), bank-statement-to-jsonl (a bank statement into one JSON object per transaction, by column geometry rather than by reading it) and bank-statement-to-dto (the statement's header onto the layer and its rows onto the client's accounts, the two halves running in parallel) — and an MCP server with five tools: export_graph, apply_graph, find_records, read_page and post_statement.
